items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: The bass player, his father was a fantastic bass player from the Sinfonica, his brother Macho, they dalled him Macho, and a piano player too.

ctx.x: The bass player, his father was a fantastic bass player from the Sinfonica, his brother Macho, they dalled him Macho, and a piano player too. The whole family were musicians. The mother was flute player and another sister was pianist and it was a musical family.
Macho, I've been learning a lot that most Cuban families, or Afro-Cuban families like the Socarras family, almost everyone in the entire family was in music. Why did they select music?
